name: splicewire/laravel-beam-embed
description: The generic embed subsystem (recohere T02): the schema-driven-CMS embed surface lifted DOWN out of tower-embed onto beam-core. Spawner / publisher / budget / usage-meter / retention / escalation / groundedness-signal / humanity-check + the capability grant/token/tier value objects + the embed models (Embed, Visitor, EmbedKey, EmbedSpendReservation, EmbedCapabilityAudit) — all tower-ref-free. KNOWLEDGE-grounding is INVERTED behind two ports (KnowledgePivotFreezer, ScopeResolver): beam-embed ships NO-OP defaults so a bare beam site works, and tower-embed binds the real tower-Thread-backed implementations. Free-tier arm of the Beam family (ADR-0138 / ADR-0092). Depends DOWN on beam-core + beam-commerce + beam-tenancy; never onto tower/satellite.

package-topology.because: beam-embed is a beam-family package: it depends DOWN on beam-core + beam-commerce + beam-tenancy + beam-threads (it hosts a thread — TH-07) and must never require the tower/satellite tiers it is consumed by
